		Dataset Overview
	

This dataset is a Query-Driven Trustworthy OS Agent Dataset implemented as described in the paper:
VeriOS: Query-Driven Proactive Human-Agent-GUI Interaction for Trustworthy OS Agents
The VeriOS dataset is designed to train and evaluate operating system (OS) agents that automate tasks through on-device graphical user interfaces (GUIs). It focuses on enabling agents to decide when to query humans for more reliable task completion… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wuuuuuz/VeriOS-Bench.
reputation: New, specialized dataset aimed at researchers building trustworthy GUI-driven OS agents; limited adoption so far outside the originating group.
